sentences.en: The general election is scheduled for next year.
sentences.zh: 下一年将举行一次普选。

sentences.en: Many people are excited about the upcoming general election.
sentences.zh: 很多人对即将举行的普选感到兴奋。

sentences.en: The results of the general election will determine who becomes the next president.
sentences.zh: 大选的结果将决定下一任总统是谁。
